name: Sequence
description:
The Sequence connector lets Claude work with your billing and revenue data, so you can answer revenue and billing questions in plain language instead of navigating dashboards and exports.

Key features:
• Look up customers — Find customers and their aliases and pull account details for context.
• Track invoices — Review invoices to find outstanding and overdue revenue.
• Inspect billing setup — Explore billing schedules, products, and price lists to see how customers are billed.
• Review credit notes — Check credit notes and adjustments alongside their related invoices.
• Report on revenue — Pull invoiced revenue to support reporting and analysis.

Note: more tools are coming soon.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sequence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sequence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://eu.sequencehq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sequence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sequence lists 18 MCP tools, including getBillingSchedule, getCreditNote, getCustomer, getInvoice, getInvoicedRevenue, getOutstandingInvoices, getProduct, getRevenueJournal, getRevenueWaterfall, listCreditNotes, listCustomerAliases, and listCustomers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sequence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sequence in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Sequence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sequence is developed by Sequence. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
